cadence_layout_apply.description: Apply the exact hashed plan within configured owned-revision authority. Retains uncertain outcomes; identical operation retries never resend a write. Save/reopen verification is separate from DRC/LVS/PEX qualification.

LayoutNativeEdit.description: Fixed worker command; geometry is complete, no arbitrary parameters/code.

LayoutOrientNativeEdit.description: Candidate fixed orientation command; native execution is not implemented.

LayoutOrientationPreview.description: Only orientation plans gain this field; legacy preview bytes stay fixed.

OrientEdit.description: Absolute instance orientation about its unchanged placement origin.

cadence_layout_diff.description: Read retained layout changes and save/reopen/source-preservation evidence against an exact previous revision; no new apply or physical verification.
cadence_layout_diff.name: cadence_layout_diff

cadence_layout_fork.description: Fork a registered source into an exclusive owned working revision. Original remains protected; operation identity prevents duplicate copies.
cadence_layout_fork.name: cadence_layout_fork

cadence_layout_inspect.description: Inspect one registered layout revision, objects and observed DBU/grid/LPP. Requires a configured development context; no caller paths or commands.
cadence_layout_inspect.name: cadence_layout_inspect

cadence_layout_plan.description: Validate typed move/add_rect/add_pin edits against an observed revision. Absolute orient edits require a qualified route. Returns exact plan hash and predicted diff; planning performs no layout write.
